revenueModel.text: Shoppers buy its apparel and accessories in stores and online.
revenueModel.evidence: ("A&F"), a company incorporated in Delaware in 1996, through its subsidiaries (collectively, A&F and its subsidiaries are referred to as the "Company"), is a global, digitally-led, omnichannel retailer.

changes.text: Reorganised around three geographic segments in fiscal 2023.
changes.evidence: During Fiscal 2023, to drive ongoing brand growth and leverage the knowledge and experience of its regional teams, the Company reorganized its structure and now primarily manages its business on a geographic basis, consisting of three reportable segments: Americas; EMEA, and APAC.
